replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always felt like a foreign language to me. I understand it's essential for science and technology, but the abstract nature of symbols and formulas makes it feel distant and intimidating. My strength lies more in chemistry and computer science, where practical application matters more than pure theory.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure to perform well in math-related tasks can trigger significant anxiety for me. I often worry about making mistakes or not understanding complex concepts quickly enough. This anxiety stems from my low openness and moderate neuroticism, making mathematical challenges feel overwhelming.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally for quick explanations of difficult concepts. While helpful, I find that relying too much on them can increase my anxiety rather than reduce it. Sometimes the AI responses are too technical and don't match my preferred learning style.
